headline: Houthis Claim Strikes on Saudi Aramco Refineries and Abqaiq Facility
summary: Yemeni Houthis claimed a series of attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure, targeting the Ras Tanura and Rabigh refineries as well as an Aramco facility at Abqaiq.
why: Saudi Aramco is the world's largest oil exporter, and attacks on its core processing and refining hubs present significant supply risks for global energy markets.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Attacks targeting critical crude processing and refining facilities introduce geopolitical risk premiums to oil prices.
